title: ACA s. 17 — Interim measures ordered by arbitral tribunal (ACA s. 17)

content.overview: Section 17 empowers the arbitral tribunal to grant specified interim measures during arbitral proceedings, including preservation, custody or sale of goods, securing the amount in dispute, detention/preservation/inspection of property or things, injunctions, receivership and other protective measures appearing just and convenient. Under section 17(2), such orders are enforceable as if they were orders of the Court, subject to the statutory terms.

Section 17 — Interim measures ordered by arbitral tribunal

Under section 17(2), such orders are enforceable as if they were orders of the Court, subject to the statutory terms.
